source.note: Captures the AI SDK DataStreamTransformer aggregation behavior for a stream containing reasoning_content + text + parallel tool calls. The Go test loads llm-think.stream.jsonl (18 frames carrying id 'msg_bdrk_01DDaPSX8bJqM5dRkdv32TkC', model 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', reasoning deltas followed by text deltas and tool_call deltas) and feeds it to NewDataStreamTransformer(). The Go test does NOT set an expectedStreamFile for this case (expectedStreamFile:'') so only the AGGREGATED UIMessage is asserted, not the per-frame output stream. The aggregated assertions: result.ID=='msg_bdrk_01DDaPSX8bJqM5dRkdv32TkC', result.Role=='assistant', and concatenating the 'reasoning'-type parts' Text yields the indicated multi-paragraph thinking string, while the 'text'-type parts' Text yields the indicated user-facing reply. Because the Go test does not pin the per-frame DataStream output for this case, the events array below is left EMPTY (rather than synthesized) and the aggregated shape is recorded in the unified_response/client_http extension fields. This case documents a real aggregated contract; per-frame DataStream sequence for this input is 'pending source snapshot' (would require Leader to add an expectedStreamFile to the Go test). selected_channel, outbound_http and upstream_http are null because the Go test does not exercise those stages.
